title: A/R Detail: money headers sort largest first
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Make sure that in the "1-30 days past due" bucket there are three open invoices, document A, document B and document C, each for a different customer, so the rows sort across customers:
  • Document A is dated 40 days ago, due 10 days ago, amount $300.00, open $50.00.
  • Document B is dated 20 days ago, due 20 days ago, amount $100.00, open $100.00.
  • Document C is dated 35 days ago, due 5 days ago, amount $200.00, open $150.00.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with the "1-30 days past due" bucket expanded.
custom_steps:
1. Click the "Amount" header.
  2. Click the "Amount" header again.
  3. Click the "Open Balance" header.
  4. Click the "Open Balance" header again.
  5. Click the "Open Balance" header a third time.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Rows inside each aging bucket sort by Amount, largest first: document A $300.00, document C $200.00, document B $100.00.

Step 2:

  • Smallest first: document B, document C, document A.

Step 3:

  • Rows inside each aging bucket sort by Open Balance, largest first: document C $150.00, document B $100.00, document A $50.00.

Step 4:

  • Smallest first: document A, document B, document C.

Step 5:

  • Largest first again, as in step 3.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header)

  • S2-R1, A/R Detail columns: “A/R Detail: Date, Location (when shown), Transaction Type, ID, Customer Full Name, Due Date, Amount, Open Balance.”
  • S2-R1: “Every column on all six reports sorts when its header is clicked, except A/P Unpaid Invoices' Vendor Name column (S2-N1). The columns are:”
  • S2-R2: “The first click gives the useful order for the kind of data: text (names, Location, Transaction Type) A to Z; money columns largest first; dates oldest first; Past Due largest first; ID and No. smallest number first (S2-R4). The second click reverses it. The third click repeats the first; there is no unsorted state.”
  • S2-R5: “On the grouped reports, a header click sorts the rows inside each group; the groups themselves never move (S1-R5, S1-R6).”
